result.detail: Deviation to record: the microarchitecture verification plan (section 5) lists apb_gpio.sby and apb_gpio_n32.sby. No formal_spec is submitted in this result, because the platform accepts exactly one formal_spec file and the plan names two. The formal proof required by interface spec section 8 is therefore still open. It needs either a follow-up task or a decision from design.rtl.interface.tech_lead on which single .sby to submit. Each testbench model mirrors its spec rules, but it was written by the same seat as the RTL, so a shared misreading would not be caught. The independent review remains required.
